source.statement: This contract is derived from reference documentation, NOT from a published machine-readable specification. VCF Automation has no specification document in VMware's Apache-2.0 vmware/vcf-api-specs repository, so there is no spec path or commit SHA to pin. Every field below was transcribed by hand from the rendered Broadcom xAPIs reference pages for the VCF Automation Provider Infrastructure APIs at version 9.1. The page URL for each operation and data structure, the operation it documents, and the date it was fetched are recorded in docs/official_sources.json.

accept_header.rule: Unless an operation states otherwise, the accept header must specify the API version, for example application/json;version=9.1.0.

authentication.rule: Authenticate with the JWT token in the Authorization header. The x-vcloud-authorization session form is deprecated and is out of scope here.

tenant_context_header.name: X-VMWARE-VCLOUD-TENANT-CONTEXT
tenant_context_header.rule: Sent only when the action is performed in an organization context; the value is the target organization's id. It is not a required header and must be absent when no organization context applies.

asynchronous_operations.rule: The server decides whether to answer synchronously or asynchronously. An asynchronous answer is HTTP 202 with an empty body; the tracking task is linked by the URI in the Location header. This reference publishes no operation for reading that task, so the task URI is opaque to this client.

pagination.rule: List endpoints are paged. page is 1-indexed.

filtering.rule: Most list endpoints accept a filter expressed in FIQL format. Equality is written field==value.

idempotency.rule: The reference publishes no idempotency-key header, no client-supplied request id and no conditional-create mechanism for these operations. A caller that must not attach the same vCenter twice has to establish that itself by querying the collection before it posts.

errors.rule: 400 for a bad request, 401 when the caller is unauthenticated or the session expired, 403 when the user is not authorized or the entity does not exist. Error payloads use the Error data structure. A 401 response carries no data structure.

operations.summary: Gets a paged list of Virtual Center servers.

filter.description: Filter for a query. FIQL format.

sortAsc.description: Field to use for ascending sort. Not used by this task.

sortDesc.description: Field to use for descending sort. Not used by this task.

headers.Location: URI of the task that monitors the request.

202.description: The request has been accepted and the task to monitor the request is in the Location header.

404.description: The specified resource was not found.

VCenterServer.description: An object representing a vCenter server.

properties_in_declaration_order.name: vcId
properties_in_declaration_order.description: URN of the associated vCenter server. Server-assigned; never sent by this client.

properties_in_declaration_order.name: name
properties_in_declaration_order.description: The name of the vCenter server.

properties_in_declaration_order.name: username
properties_in_declaration_order.description: User name to connect to the server.

properties_in_declaration_order.name: password
properties_in_declaration_order.description: Cleartext password to connect to the server.

properties_in_declaration_order.name: isEnabled
properties_in_declaration_order.description: True if the vCenter server is enabled for use.

VCenterServers.description: A list of vCenter servers: allOf Page plus values.

Page.description: Paging metadata composed into list responses.

Error.description: Error type format displayed to users for exceptions emerging from openapi endpoints.

exercise_profile.purpose: Pins the exact wire shape this task is verified against. The loopback fixture serves these two operations and nothing else.

conditional.X-VMWARE-VCLOUD-TENANT-CONTEXT: Sent only when the client was constructed with a non-blank organization id, and then on both requests. Absent otherwise.

percent_encoding.rule: Every character of a query parameter value outside the unreserved set [A-Za-z0-9-._] is percent-encoded with uppercase hex. In particular the FIQL == operator is sent as %3D%3D. No other parameter is sent.

attach_virtual_center_request.omission_rule: A property is present only when the caller supplied a value for it. An unset optional property is omitted entirely: it is never sent as null, as an empty string, as an empty object, or as a placeholder. description is omitted when it is null or blank; isEnabled is omitted when it is null. No other VCenterServer property is ever sent, including vcId.
attach_virtual_center_request.encoding: Compact JSON with no whitespace between tokens, encoded as UTF-8. Non-ASCII characters are sent as UTF-8 bytes, never as \u escapes. Quotation marks and backslashes inside string values are escaped as \" and \\.

worked_example.inputs: name=vc-sample, description unset, username=svc@vsphere.local, password=<secret>, url=https://vc-sample.lab.example.com, isEnabled unset

retry_safety.rule: Attach Virtual Center is a mutating call with no server-side idempotency mechanism, so the client provides it: exactly one Query Virtual Centers request is issued first, filtered on the vCenter url. If the filtered page already contains an entry whose url is exactly the requested url, the client reports the existing attachment and issues no POST at all. Only when the filtered page contains no such entry does the client issue exactly one POST.
retry_safety.ambiguity: More than one entry in the filtered page matching the requested url is an inconsistent inventory, not a match.
